visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a beige cap with a red logo and blue-tinted aviator sunglasses, stands in front of a bright indoor background, speaking directly to the camera with a playful expression. (2) A woman with black hair and straight bangs, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt and a delicate gold necklace, appears on screen; she smiles warmly and touches her cheek with her hand, showcasing her smooth skin against a neutral curtain background. (3) A montage of family photos displays the woman and a man with two young daughters in various outdoor settings including a park with a windmill, a restaurant, and a historic monument in Paris. (4) The woman explains a skincare routine, showing a close-up comparison of her facial skin with 'Before' and 'After' labels; she holds a clear bottle of Kiehl's serum while applying it to her cheek. (5) A side-by-side product test compares two liquid droplets on a white surface, one remaining clear and the other turning yellow, while the woman points to the Kiehl's bottle. (6) The woman holds a blue and white bottle of Kiehl's Retinol serum, gesturing toward her face to emphasize its firming effects with pink graphic text overlays. (7) In the final scene, the woman and the young girl appear together in a split-screen layout, both gesturing excitedly toward the camera in front of a display of numerous Kiehl's skincare products and gift sets.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天我要宣布. [Logo]: @kellyshen40. (2) [Variety]: 誤會. [Subtitle]: 我媽在法國被誤會了. (3) [Subtitle]: 上個月跟姊姊去巴黎玩的時候, 在地鐵上竟然有人以為我們是姊妹. (4) [Variety]: 心臟暴擊. [Subtitle]: 而且她去商店買東西, 也有人以為我們是姊妹. (5) [Subtitle]: 凱莉哥女士請跟我道歉. (6) [Subtitle]: 大家都對不起. 我用契爾氏早C晚A把女兒養成了妹妹, 真的好開心噢. (7) [Slogan]: 早C晚A是什麼東西. (8) [Slogan]: After. Before. 亮. (9) [Subtitle]: 看我以前的照片跟現在臉有沒有亮很多. 因為我每天都用這瓶契爾氏淡斑精華. (10) [Logo]: Kiehl's. [Slogan]: 契爾氏淡斑精華. 他牌維他命C. (11) [Slogan]: 乙基左旋維他命C 穩定性高不會氧化. 全臉均勻亮白. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且我的臉不只亮, 還很彈喔. 裡面有加普拉斯鏈抗老, 受損的膠原蛋白都被撐起來了, 臉就澎出來了. (13) [Variety]: 澎. 緊緻. 拉提. (14) [Slogan]: 契爾氏A醇精華. 添加神經醯胺、胜肽. (15) [Subtitle]: 晚A就是契爾氏A醇精華. 改善細紋、皺紋. (16) [Slogan]: 眼角的細紋. 下垂的蘋果肌. 毛孔粗大. (17) [Subtitle]: 擦完從來沒有脫皮過. 而且那些眼角的細紋、下垂的蘋果肌、還有毛孔粗大, 真的都會消失. 感覺整個臉都被提上去了. (18) [Subtitle]: 誰懂自己的媽媽竟然沒有皺紋的感受. (19) [Slogan]: 比出國還划算. 契爾氏官網連選3天. 18%回饋. 全館9折+免運. 明星組合最低28折.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous family anecdote about a mother being mistaken for her daughter's sister in Paris to segue into an endorsement for Kiehl's 'Morning C, Night A' skincare routine, highlighting its anti-aging and brightening effects to promote a 618 shopping festival sale.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Kiehl's product bottles, technical explanation of ingredients (Vitamin C, Retinol), and detailed promotional price information for the official website sale.
